provenance.notes: Baseline reconstruction used for image-quality metrics. Optional enhancement stages are disabled so measurements reflect optics, the sensor, and the mandatory colour reconstruction rather than denoise or sharpening.
assumptions: Malvar-He-Cutler demosaicing is the default Bayer reconstruction
the colour-correction matrix is the neutral identity until per-illuminant matrices are fitted
denoise and sharpening are disabled for the baseline measurement profile
tone mapping uses the standard sRGB opto-electronic transfer function
